2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 25.05.1998 passed by XIth Additional Sessions Judge, Muzaffarnagar.

The First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffarnagar vide order dated 12.06.1997 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo one year rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 2000/-
under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffarnagar

sentences.text: Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 62 of 1997 and Appellate Court while dismissing appeal confirmed order of conviction passed by Trial Court but reduced the sentence from two years to one year rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/-.
Being aggrieved the revisionists preferred present revision.
